name: Light's Hope Chapel
summary: Light's Hope Chapel is a sacred sanctuary situated in the eastern reaches of the Plaguelands, serving as the primary redoubt and headquarters for the Argent Dawn. Once a secluded shrine of the Church of the Holy Light in the Eastweald, it now stands as an enduring bulwark against the Scourge. Beneath its consecrated soil lie the remains of a thousand fallen heroes of Lordaeron, protected from the Lich King's necromancy.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Plaguelands
sections.body: Originally founded centuries ago as an outpost of the Church of the Holy Light within the verdant Eastweald, Light's Hope Chapel endured the fall of Lordaeron to become a vital shelter in a blighted realm. When the zealous extremists among the survivors splintered to form the Scarlet Crusade, more temperate knights and priests banded together to establish the Argent Dawn. Choosing this secluded, hallowed site as their forward base of operations, the Dawn opened its doors to all races and factions—Alliance and Horde alike—united in the common crusade to purge the Scourge and reclaim the northern lands.

sections.title: The Consecrated Crypts
sections.body: The strategic importance of Light's Hope Chapel goes far deeper than its surface fortifications. Following the Third War, Lord Maxwell Tyrosus and his comrades carried out a clandestine, solemn mission across Lordaeron, unearthing the bodies of a thousand revered heroes of the Light and reinterring them within the catacombs beneath the chapel. This mass reburial was enacted specifically to safeguard their sacred remains and righteous souls from being corrupted and raised into the Lich King's armies. As a result, the ground here radiates a profound holy power that the Scourge has repeatedly sought—and failed—to extinguish.

faq.q: Why are Alliance and Horde working together at Light's Hope Chapel?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn views the Scourge as an existential threat to all living beings, transcending the bitter politics of the Alliance and Horde. Unlike the fanatical and human-supremacist Scarlet Crusade, the Dawn actively recruits capable warriors, shamans, druids, and priests from any people willing to fight against the undead.

aliases: who is in charge of lights hope
faq.answer: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus leads the Argent Dawn from Light's Hope Chapel, having stepped up after the death of the order's first leader, Lord Raymond George. Tyrosus personally led the efforts to inter Lordaeron's fallen heroes in the chapel's catacombs and successfully repelled significant Scourge incursions against the outpost.

faq.q: Why is this chapel so sacred?
aliases: why does the scourge want lights hope
faq.answer: Beyond being an ancient holy site built during the early expansion of the Church of the Holy Light, the catacombs beneath the building hold the recovered remains of a thousand fallen champions of Lordaeron. The concentrated holy essence interred in the sacred ground shields these souls from being raised into undeath by the Lich King.

faq.q: What relationship does the chapel have with the Scarlet Crusade?
aliases: are they friends with scarlet crusade
faq.answer: While the Argent Dawn formed from paladins and priests who rejected the unhinged zealotry and isolationism of the Scarlet Crusade, the two orders still share a common enemy in the Scourge. The Dawn fights it on its own terms from the chapel, open to all who would stand against the undead.

angles.text: For holy warriors, Light's Hope Chapel is a sacred beacon in a sea of death, housing the consecrated tombs of the Silver Hand's greatest fallen champions.
Though situated deep in human territory and run by former Silver Hand knights, the chapel welcomes Horde fighters who prove their dedication to eradicating the undead.
